parentLift.note: Leg drive moves more weight than a strict press, so it counts at three quarters.

tagline: Dip, drive with the legs, and send it overhead.

coaching.summary: With the bar resting on the front of your shoulders, dip a few inches at the knees, drive up hard with the legs, and press the bar overhead to lockout.
cues: Dip straight down a few inches with the torso upright and heels planted.
Reverse the dip fast so the legs launch the bar off the shoulders.
Press through to lockout with the bar over the middle of the foot.

standardsRef.note: Leg drive lets most lifters push press about a fifth more than they press.
